writing.overall_comment: A well-scoped, high-quality subagent definition with strong boundaries and output contract, held back mainly by redundant sections and token-heavy generic code examples that could be trimmed.

dimensions.name: Delegation fit
dimensions.comment: Description names concrete triggers (Fiber API, Cobra CLI, GORM, clean architecture) so a main agent can route with confidence.

dimensions.name: Prompt quality
dimensions.comment: Role, layered implementation contract, do/don't constraints, and a clear output contract with build/test commands and assumption reporting are all explicit.

dimensions.name: Boundaries
dimensions.comment: Dedicated handoff section clearly scopes to Go backend only and specifies when to return to the main agent or system-architect.

dimensions.name: Conciseness
dimensions.comment: The file is verbose: the 专业领域 and 集成技能 lists overlap, and generic code samples (Fiber handler, GORM repo, table-driven test) plus standard framework knowledge consume token budget without adding agent-specific value.

suggestions: Merge the overlapping 专业领域 and 集成技能 lists in the reviewed profile file into a single deduplicated skills section to reduce repetition.

Remove or heavily condense the generic Fiber handler, GORM repository, and table-driven test code samples from the reviewed profile file because they consume tokens without adding agent-specific value.
Trim standard framework knowledge from the reviewed profile file and replace it with concise agent-specific capabilities or constraints to improve value per token.
